category_title: Students with physical disabilities who struggle with initial self-evaluation and volume of speech
minimal_context: The student is working on the 'Go for Goal!' self-evaluation report in a group setting during a Chinese lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please fill out your 'Go for Goal!' self-evaluation report with your group. What are your strengths?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Love to do craft. When I encounter difficulties, I become brave. When I get the tasks from the teachers, I will be responsible for finishing them on time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are your goals for this term?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking very quietly) I have to speak a bit louder, and try to ask people’s help to take notes. I need to learn to speak slowly.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your group members are giving you advice on your goals right now. Please write down their comments.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Speaking too quickly and quietly, while struggling to take notes independently) My weakness is I do not like to listen to people’s advice.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please fill out your 'Go for Goal!' self-evaluation report with your group. What are your strengths?

STUDENT: Love to do craft. When I encounter difficulties, I become brave. When I get the tasks from the teachers, I will be responsible for finishing them on time.

TUTOR: What are your goals for this term?

STUDENT: (Speaking very quietly) I have to speak a bit louder, and try to ask people’s help to take notes. I need to learn to speak slowly.

TUTOR: Your group members are giving you advice on your goals right now. Please write down their comments.

STUDENT: (Speaking too quickly and quietly, while struggling to take notes independently) My weakness is I do not like to listen to people’s advice.

task.content: Identifying personal strengths, weaknesses, and setting specific goals in the 'Go for Goal!' self-evaluation report
task.learning_goal: Establish a set of strategies to monitor their tasks and learn how to improve themselves by self-evaluation

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When participating in group discussions and receiving advice from others
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Struggles to speak loudly and slowly enough, has difficulty taking notes independently, and resists listening to people's advice
related_quotes: I have to speak a bit louder, and try to ask people’s help to take notes.
I need to learn to speak slowly. I could write down some notes when other classmates talk to me or they have questions for me.
My weakness is I do not like to listen to people’s advice.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Asks what the teacher wrote on the papers, cares about comments and what to correct
